correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md, SLOGAN.txt and both checked artifact files from the frozen assigned Git tree. Independent Python reconstruction parsed the 50 decimal columns as nonzero distinct 10-bit vectors and enumerated all 1024 syndromes, all 50 one-column deletions and all binomial(50,2)=1225 distinct pair deletions without sampling. For each pair, two mathematically equivalent but operationally different finite tests agreed: (i) 1024 minus the cardinality of the shortened 0/one/two-XOR sumset, and (ii) count of syndromes all of whose original representation-support bitmasks intersect that deleted pair. The 1276 supports include 0, 50 singles and 1225 unordered doubles, and every syndrome has at least one. Exact histogram (27:9,31:6,40:12,45:29,47:94,49:3,53:6,54:48,56:69,59:46,61:71,62:6,65:6,73:608,74:87,76:35,78:11,79:78,92:1) sums to 1225; minimum 27 has exactly nine minimizers as claimed; source coverage 1024/1024 and independent one-deletion min9 at 381/479/927 match primary literature. Both original and independently reconstructed full Git tree hashes agree with assigned b5af...; this is exhaustive finite evidence, not a claim about all other 48/49-column codes.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The surrounding source proves radius-two coverage, one-column local optimality, and stronger restricted 49-column exchange-search exclusion. None of those stated conclusions yields the exact missing-syndrome counts of every 48-column two-deletion seed; even knowing that no single-column addition repairs a 48-set does not fix whether its raw deficit is 27, 73, or another value. The audited result neither supersedes these broader global questions nor infers a global length-function bound.

value.rationale: The studied object is the explicit currently improved 50-column length seed used to construct infinite radius-two code families, and column shortening/repair is a natural central operation when seeking smaller redundancy-ten covering codes. The exact second-deletion defect u2=27, classification of all nine best deleted pairs and complete distribution over 1225 choices are a natural, finite, previously unreported stability invariant of this code, beyond merely proving local one-column minimality. Precise per-pair deficits can serve as checks and prioritization data for future column-replacement and code-exchange investigations. The result is self-contained and exhaustive, and its value does not depend on proving a new global code-length bound. It would be misdescribed as a general lower bound or as showing a 48/49-column cover is impossible.

limitations: Finite exhaustive profile only for the specified printed 10x50 matrix; unrelated 48- or 49-column binary radius-two covering matrices are not ruled out.
The completed scientific audit does not certify novelty against all possible unpublished data or unavailable later revision full text.
The two code paths implement equivalent math but do not substitute for an external formal proof assistant or third-party independent attestation.
